about: Clearview is a township in Simcoe County, Ontario, spanning Stayner, Creemore, Nottawa, and surrounding farm and Niagara Escarpment edge country below the Blue Mountains. Distinct villages share one municipal government rather than forming a single city. Highways 26 and 91 link the township to Barrie and Collingwood. About 15,000 people live in Clearview.
